documentation: v2 schema rules: use only accurate, visible and verified data. Placeholders are not publishable values.

organization_template.name: DATA REQUIRED — approved legal / international brand name
sameAs: DATA REQUIRED — verified Facebook/other official profile

service_template.name: DATA REQUIRED — confirmed service
service_template.description: DATA REQUIRED — factual visible page description

software_application_template.name: DATA REQUIRED — confirmed product
software_application_template.description: DATA REQUIRED — factual visible product description
software_application_template.offers: DATA REQUIRED — current pricing/offer if public

rules: Do not publish Review or AggregateRating schema for placeholder testimonials.
Do not use LocalBusiness for US/AU/UK without a factual local business presence.
Use FAQPage only for visible, helpful FAQs that reflect real buyer questions.
Use Person/Article only for real named authors and reviewers.
Validate structured data against the published page, not a content draft.
